description: This file defines the 'Report' interface within the 'OrangeHRM' human resource management system. It specifies methods related to obtaining header and filter definitions, as well as generating report data based on filter parameters.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: An interface outlining methods for report header, filter definitions, and data retrieval based on filters.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report, used for table headers.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter definition for the report, used for filtering data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data tailored to provided filter parameters.
